subject: Quick note on BD&H's website
bodyText:
Hi,

I'm Mani from Rogue.

We look for solid businesses that still look stuck online - and BD&H stood out.

Norwich litho, screen and digital printers on Europa Way - and bdandh.co.uk still runs a Dreamweaver MM_swapImage table layout, stamps ©2012 in the footer, and keeps Fax 01603 630186 live next to sales. Proper print house; a shopfront frozen on mid-2010s image-rollover HTML.

If useful, I'll send a short 3-point teardown over email - what's dated, what's costing you, and the first fix. No call required.

Reply YES and I'll send it.
